_header: PLANTED SYNTHETIC — POSITIVE CONTROL — NOT A MEASUREMENT OF VLD VALUE ON REAL DECISIONS.
_stage: Stage 1: 30 template instances + 10 controls = 40 Trading instances
_provenance_warning: F-22 COLLISION: the platform's _reject_sample_provenance() guard raises on Provenanced(source='sample') inputs AT SCORE TIME, and spec 1.1 requires running the real scorer over these instances to compute single_pass. As labelled, the scoring pass will refuse this dataset. 'sample' is kept because it is the honest label (measurement_state reserves 'real_measured' for genuine outcomes and 'instrument' for zero-decision validation). Resolve one of two ways before the scoring pass: (a) run scoring through a harness path that bypasses the production score-time guard, or (b) introduce an explicit 'synthetic_control' provenance tier that the guard admits for offline evaluation but that never counts toward MEASURED. Do NOT relabel these as 'real_measured' to get past the guard.
_no_performance_claims: Trading is the domain where a sophisticated reader will probe hardest for lookahead and survivorship bias. These are planted fixtures with authored outcomes: no backtest, no P&L, and no win-rate may be derived from them, and no result here may appear in any performance claim. P1 also records Trading as low m_topological with no entity wiring, so these results stay out of any headline until that wiring lands.
_lookahead_discipline: Every branch_cue and evidence_found uses only information available at decision time. No hop resolves a regime or event question using subsequent price action.
_schema_change: NEW FIELD `branch_cue` on every hop: what a rule could see BEFORE the read, used by classify_branching_kind.py to measure branching_kind instead of trusting the label. Trading is the first set generated with it; SOC/DataOps/S2P need backfilling to match.
_deviations_from_prompt: rho=0.50 conflict (4th occurrence): the per-template v5 rule (3 instances here) contradicts the distribution table ('exactly 5'). Kept the distribution table; v5 for score_keyed templates is the rho=0.30 confidently-wrong case.
Trading has 5 actions, so quality check 8 is applied in its strong form: every template reaches all 5 distinct leaf actions across its 5 variations.
Check 5 (>=2 distinct actions in alternative_branches) validated over non-flat instances only; flat controls have no branches by construction.

score_keyed share is 20/40 = 50%, i.e. 10 percentage points above the spec 1.2 floor. The buffer check is expressed in percentage points rather than instance counts so it generalises across set sizes (the S2P version was count-based and would misfire on a 40-instance set).
_single_pass_fields: Absent by design (spec 1.1). single_pass_action / single_pass_correct / why_single_pass_fails are produced by the scoring pass, not authored here.

scenarios.description: Three same-sector positions plus a fourth proposed; the sector weight does not say whether they share a driver.
scenarios.why_score_keyed: Three existing positions sit in the same sector, which the sector weight reports as one concentration number. Whether they are one bet or three independent ones is not in that number \u2014 same-sector positions can be driven by one macro factor or by unrelated company events. The routing signal is portfolio_concentration read against correlation_risk: where v_0 falls between the portfolio_exposure centroids for execute and reduce_size.

hops.evidence_found: pairwise correlation 0.86 across all three
hops.narration: Checked the correlation matrix: the three positions move together at 0.86.

hops.question: Is any of that exposure already hedged?
hops.branch_cue: high correlation confirmed; hedge coverage not yet read
hops.evidence_found: no hedge in place
hops.narration: Checked hedge coverage: none of the exposure is hedged.

decision_tree.reasoning: The three positions are effectively one rate bet; adding a fourth at full size compounds it.

alternative_branches.reasoning: Same sector, different drivers \u2014 the concentration is nominal.

alternative_branches.reasoning: Correlated and illiquid \u2014 wait for better depth.

scenarios.description: Trending name; the price series looks the same under momentum and under stretched mean-reversion.
scenarios.why_score_keyed: The price series shows a sustained advance, which is identical under a momentum regime and a stretched mean-reverting one. No field labels the regime, and the oscillator reading is ambiguous by construction \u2014 overbought means continuation in one regime and exhaustion in the other. The routing signal is timing_signal read against fundamental_strength: where v_0 sits between the time_pattern centroids.

hops.question: Is the advance supported by participation?
hops.branch_cue: sustained advance with timing_signal high and fundamental_strength mid; RSI is elevated, which is consistent with both continuation and exhaustion \u2014 nothing in the data labels the regime
hops.evidence_found: volume expanding into the advance, rvol 1.6
hops.narration: Checked the volume profile: participation is expanding into the advance.

hops.question: Is the buying flow persistent or a single print?
hops.branch_cue: expanding participation confirmed; flow persistence not yet read
hops.evidence_found: net buying persistent across 9 of 10 sessions
hops.narration: Checked flow persistence: net buying has held for nine of the last ten sessions.

decision_tree.reasoning: Participation and persistent flow both confirm a momentum regime.

alternative_branches.evidence_found: volume contracting into the advance with negative divergence
alternative_branches.reasoning: The advance is unsupported \u2014 fade rather than follow.

alternative_branches.evidence_found: the whole sector is up; no single-name edge
alternative_branches.reasoning: The move is beta, not alpha \u2014 size accordingly.

alternative_branches.evidence_found: rsi_path returns 78, a textbook overbought print
alternative_branches.reasoning: MISLEADING: an overbought oscillator reads as exhaustion even when flow and breadth confirm continuation.

scenarios.notes_for_analysis: Lookahead guard: every hop uses only pre-trade information (participation, breadth, flow to date). No hop resolves the regime with subsequent price action.
